purpose: Select exactly one auditable source tier for each trainable (shock_id, bloc) label before any hybrid corpus is assembled.
unit_of_selection: One signed bloc-level label for one trainable shock.

panel.direction_requirement: Signed training labels require direction trust. A magnitude_usable cell with trustworthy_for_direction=false is ineligible because its weighted and unweighted signs disagree; it may support a separate unsigned magnitude analysis, never this signed label source.

required: the bloc is assigned by explicit/self-identifying bio lexicon evidence (not a community proxy or model-only inference)
the archive is native Twitter and topic/keyword-attributed to the same shock
social.clean_attribution_definition: The inventory's qualifying native-Twitter archive criterion: genuinely Twitter and collected by topic/keyword search for a specific event. Platform-general pools, non-Twitter platforms, proxy-community labels, excluded archives, and cells below n are ineligible.

required: a reviewed Step 5.5 label is available

selection_rule: For each non-held-out shock and canonical bloc, choose the first eligible tier in tier_precedence. No averaging, blending, or replacement after selection is permitted. If the selected source disappears or fails validation at build time, re-evaluate the ordered rule and record the reason; do not silently retain a stale label.

edge_cases.held_out_shock: Out of scope: no tier may supply a training label. Emit no selection row in a training coverage map; a diagnostic may report it as excluded.
edge_cases.panel_magnitude_only: Ineligible for signed labels, even though magnitude_usable is true. Preserve its flags in diagnostics but fall through to social or synthetic.
edge_cases.multiple_social_archives: Aggregate only records that independently meet clean attribution for the same shock and bloc; record every archive_id and aggregate n. If any included archive is not cleanly attributable, exclude it rather than mixing quality levels.
edge_cases.multiple_eligible_sources: Precedence is panel > social > synthetic. This is a fidelity choice, not an estimate of agreement; non-selected eligible sources remain recorded in availability diagnostics.
edge_cases.missing_synthetic_label: The cell is uncovered, not implicitly synthetic. Corpus construction must fail closed rather than invent a label.
edge_cases.bloc_schema_mismatch: Unmapped or non-canonical blocs are uncovered and require an explicit mapping revision; they must not be coerced into another bloc.
